Name: Redesigned Ranching Farm
Author: Peekabo0
Description:
[size=4]Hello again [color=#a4c2f4]૮₍˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶ ₎ა[/color]

As I published in a post, this farm is the Ranching farm redesigned for a custom-designed visual and aesthetic improvement.

This farm is a replacement for the vanilla farm ([color=#ffe599]I plan to add it as a separate farm when I have the others made[/color]) with two versions:

- The first has arable land and [color=#e06666]NON-arable[/color] grass.
- The second has [color=#93c47d]completely arable[/color] grass.

In this farm you can also fish [color=#ffd966]mountain[/color] [color=#a2c4c9]fishes[/color]! [color=#a4c2f4]◝(ᵔᗜᵔ)◜[/color]

[color=#b6d7a8]For this farm you only need:[/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

[color=#b6d7a8]Installation:[/color]

- Download the farm.
-Unzip and copy the file to your mods folder.[/size]
[size=4]-Enjoy![/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=6]ฅᨐฅ[/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4]Thank you for downloading this mod, I hope you like it and enjoy this farm. Any errors or bugs you find Exclusively on this map, let me know and I will fix it as quickly as I can. [/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4]I hope to see you soon, thank you [/size][/color][color=#a4c2f4][size=4]૮₍ ˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶ ₎ა[/size][/color]
